description: You are perched on a precarious wooden shelf high above the floor. Dusty slippers and forgotten flip-flops rest here in eternal silence. The view is dizzying.

wall.description: The back of the wooden shelf. It's solid and splintery.

shelf_floor.description: The smooth, dusty wood of the shelf.

dusty_slipper.onInteract: You look at the faded pink velvet slipper. It's napping peacefully, snoring a tiny cloud of dust. Best not to wake it.
dusty_slipper.description: A forgotten pink slipper, napping in the corner.

old_flipflop.onInteract: You check out the blue rubber flip-flop. It has a broken strap but looks back at you with a chill, relaxed vibe. 'Stay cool, shoe,' it seems to say.
old_flipflop.description: A relaxed-looking blue flip-flop resting on the shelf.

item.name: Wild Potato
item.onCollect: You open the smallest shoebox and find a perfectly fresh Wild Potato! A wonderful starchy surprise!

shoebox_corner.description: A stack of tiny, miniature shoebox lids in the corner.

exit_south.description: A hole in the shelf leads back down to the neighbor's house.

exit_west.description: The shelf continues west to a dark corner.

exit_east.description: A narrow ledge leads east toward the window.

item_lace.description: A pristine, extra-long shoelace is coiled neatly here.
